protocol_content.title: Dynamic fluid-responsiveness guidance for sepsis and septic shock
protocol_content.research_question: Among adults with sepsis or septic shock, compare intravenous-fluid resuscitation guided by dynamic measures of fluid responsiveness with no dynamic guidance for prespecified patient-important clinical and resuscitative outcomes.
protocol_content.review_criteria: Include randomized controlled trials enrolling adults aged 18 years or older with sepsis or septic shock, including severe-infection populations eligible under the registered protocol, with at least one arm using dynamic measures of fluid responsiveness to guide intravenous-fluid administration and a comparator arm without dynamic guidance.

result_targets.population: Adults aged 18 years or older with sepsis or septic shock.

comparator.label: no dynamic measures of fluid responsiveness
aliases: no dynamic measures of fluid responsiveness

result_targets.outcome_definition: All-cause mortality at 28 days, or the closest reported all-cause mortality timepoint when day 28 is unavailable.
result_targets.timepoint: 28 days after randomization preferred; otherwise the closest reported timepoint.
result_targets.analysis_population: Participants in the arm-level outcome analysis population reported by the eligible randomized trial.
result_targets.selection_rule: Prefer directly reported arm-level deaths and denominators at 28 days; if unavailable, use the closest reported all-cause mortality timepoint. Keep the separately prespecified ICU-mortality outcome under its own target.
